calls.title: Manager Onboarding w. Jeremy
calls.summary: The meeting outlined the onboarding process aimed at integrating new engineers swiftly, enabling them to ship code within their first week. It highlighted Teresa Yung's experience in onboarding without a laptop and her initial setup of essential tools. The engineering team, which is globally distributed, consists of four main squads: feature flag, experimentation, product analytics, and platform, each addressing specific product needs. The company emphasizes flexible data infrastructure, connecting to customer warehouses with robust SQL capabilities. Additionally, the team upholds pragmatic testing practices and operates under a continuous deployment model for efficient feature rollout. Future plans include expanding the team and promoting a culture of collaboration and learning.
calls.keywords: Onboarding, Feature Flags, Product Analytics, DevOps, Experiments, Growth Book Platform

calls.title: Manager Onboarding w. Jeremy
calls.summary: The meeting covered key aspects of the onboarding process for new hires, emphasizing swift integration with tools and a buddy system to expedite learning. The engineering team is organized into squads to maximize expertise and operates across different global locations for around-the-clock support. Additionally, the discussion highlighted the feature flag system's flexibility and usage analytics, which support clean code management. A monorepo architecture is utilized for development, allowing streamlined CI/CD processes with regular code releases, while attention to data reliability is ensured through Kafka integration and alert systems. The strategic vision aims for a developer-friendly product with an emphasis on transparent analytics, aligning with an open-core model for enterprise growth.
calls.keywords: Onboarding, Feature Flagging, Experimentation, Product Analytics, Infrastructure, Data Warehouse
